annotations.title: When a North Carolina (NC) Administrative Code rule changed, and how

description:
When a North Carolina Administrative Code (NCAC) rule was adopted, amended or repealed,
and exactly what changed.

Returns OAH's history events (dated: adopted, amended, temporary or emergency adoption,
readopted, repealed, expired, transferred, recodified) and the versions of the text this
server has stored, with a word-level diff between two of them — the latest two by default,
or the versions in force on `from_date` and `to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). `format` is "unified",
"html" or "both". Stored versions begin with the first weekly crawl, so older changes
have dates but no diff.

from_date.description: The earlier date (YYYY-MM-DD): diff the version in force then against the one at to_date. Omit both for the latest two stored versions.

to_date.description: The later date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the latest stored version.
